title: Research: classify P112 sparse-lift equality and sharp all-active cost 65
body:
Mihir Srivastava's incorporated PR845 already proves that a real single lift with fixed P112 coordinate readers cannot beat copy cost 64. This scoped structural refinement fixes the ninth normal to the sum of three coordinate normals and classifies **all minimum-cost per-root shifts**: exactly `t=0,r0,r1,r2`, each using eight active terms. Requiring all nine terms active has sharp cost **65**, attained by `(8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,1)`. Arbitrary complex row shifts are covered; the normal frame is fixed.

The added package contains a written universal argument with two complete finite compatibility lemmas, exact witnesses and a separate affine-plane/rank-nullity implementation. It checks 32,385 binary planes and 765 single functions, plus every entry of five sharp decoder witnesses. It claims neither priority for the 64 floor nor a general nine-normal theorem. No physical supplier, changed paid histogram, moment barrier or new kappa is claimed.

Validation: full registered Python 3.12.13 replay, six package test groups, optimized Python 3.14.7 replay, receipt/source corruptions, read-only relocation, 20 research tests (one existing skip), five selected-record regressions and source-integrity checks pass. Full selected cold replay, native admission, Lean, hosted-CI success and independent human review are not claimed.

Only `research/sparse-redundant-decoder/` is added. Base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; original OS seed 40. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/sparse-redundant-decoder
```

Credit PR845/mihir-s-05 for the prior single-lift obstruction, PR620/GamingPuzzled for coordinate cost 64, PR1224/joaqcoo for the general representation, PR1248 for the deficiency-plane method, and the retained PR446/717/968/1077 lineage. PR1304's A8 P112 frame is distinct. Source heads, overlap and open questions are recorded in the package. Prepared for Philipp/@mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in research, proof, implementation, checking and writing; Apache-2.0.
